actions.run.description: Runs another action by its name and waits until it is done. It gets a copy of this action's variables. Fails when no action has that name.

parameters.name: The action's name as shown on the Actions page, like "Shoutout". Upper or lower case does not matter.

actions.run.returns: true when the action finished without errors, otherwise false.

actions.cancel.description: Stops the runs of an action that are going on or waiting in a queue. A run stops at its next step or wait. Fails when no action has that name.

parameters.name: The action's name. Leave it empty for the action this script is in.
parameters.includePending: Optional. false leaves runs waiting in a queue alone. Starts as true.
parameters.includeThisRun: Optional. true also stops the run this script is in. Starts as false, which keeps this run and whatever started it going.
